content: विलक्षण {%a.%} .²1 Having no characteristic or distinguishing marks. .²2 Different, other; ततश्च कर्माणि विलक्षणानि <ls>Bhāg. 11. 23. 44</ls>. .²3 Strange, extraordinary, unusual; तस्मै नमस्ते स्वविलक्षणात्मने <ls>Bhāg. 10. 70. 38</ls>. .²4 Possessed of inauspicious marks. .²5 Lustreless, bad-looking; उद्वीक्ष्योद्वीक्ष्य नयनैर्भयादिव विलक्षणैः <ls>Rām. 3. 52. 41</ls>. .{@-णम्@} .²1 A vain or useless state. .²2 Perceiving, observing.
